parsed.name: AG-UC2 两轴压电微步运动控制器
parsed.description: 这是一台用于驱动两路微位移轴的运动控制器，可控制 X/Y 两个轴进行相对步进、连续点动、限位移动与零点设定，并支持步幅和步延时等参数设置。它常用于光学对准、精密微位移调整和实验平台上的双轴定位任务。
parsed.description_en: This is a two-axis motion controller for driving micro-positioning axes. It controls X and Y axes for relative stepping, continuous jogging, motion toward limits, and zero-position definition, with adjustable step amplitude and step delay. It is commonly used for optical alignment, precision micro-positioning, and dual-axis positioning tasks in laboratory setups.
